item.title: AI-generated child sexual abuse case impacts former Cascade residents
item.description: The state of Utah is prosecuting a former Cascade resident, a man named Dalten Bryne Montana Johnson, on six counts of sexual exploitation of a minor.

item.title: Before embarking on Boise State career, Mason Quinn leading Frenchtown among Class A's best
item.description: Mason Quinn has been a four-year star for Frenchtown, and in her final season before heading to Boise State, she's leading the Broncs to plenty of success as a senior.

item.title: Montana Ag Network: Embracing nonsense at The Nonsense Ranch
item.description: A Missoula couple has taken in more than 100 animals, most with special needs. They keep the ranch running with help from the community and a hand from a dedicated high school student.
